summary: Frontend-only validation of two new features + regression. BOTH features PASS. Feature 1 (Smart Digest Tuning): notif-digest-time row appears only when Daily summary toggle is ON; tapping it opens digest-time-sheet with all six preset options (7,8,9,12,18,21); selecting 6:00 PM (option-18) updates both the Summary time value AND the Daily summary subtitle to '6:00 PM', and toggling Daily summary OFF hides the notif-digest-time row. Feature 2 (Overdue Quick Snooze): each of the 3 seeded overdue awaits renders overdue-snooze-<id> footer with 'Tomorrow', '+3 days', 'Next week' chips and an overdue-snooze-more-<id> 'More' button; tapping a chip fires POST /api/awaits/{id}/snooze → 200 and shows a 'Reminder set · <date>' toast (verified: 'Reminder set · Thu, 24 Sep' for Next week) without navigating away; tapping 'More' opens the overdue-remind-<id> SnoozeSheet with contextual options. Regression: Home still renders Today/Upcoming/Overdue sections with correct counts (0/2/3); non-overdue AwaitCard tap navigates to /item/<id> detail (verified Rahul → /item/aw_38a6ca0438a2). One minor observation only: after a successful snooze the item's due pill on Home remains 'X days late' for a beat because the react-query invalidation refetch has not yet returned when the toast fires; the toast + API 200 confirm success and the request unequivocally succeeded — no blocking issue.
critical_code_review_comments: app/settings/notifications.tsx:88-96 — Sheet preset keys use the hour as string (7,8,9,12,18,21) and 'custom' branch is web-gated correctly (Platform.OS !== 'web'), so web preview correctly hides the 'Pick a time…' option while native still exposes DateTimePicker. Clean.
app/settings/notifications.tsx:62-64 — 'notif-digest-time' row is conditionally rendered on prefs.notifDaily. Correctly hides when Daily summary is turned OFF. Verified via UI test.

app/(tabs)/index.tsx:195-233 OverdueItem — snooze quick actions use dayjs().add(days,'day').hour(9).minute(0) which is a sensible 9 AM tomorrow/+3/next-week. onSuccess correctly closes the sheet and shows toast. Non-blocking observation: pill on Home doesn't visibly update between the mutation return and the react-query refetch settling; consider showing an optimistic update or a subtle 'Snoozed' badge if UX polish is desired.
src/prefs.tsx — digestHour/digestMinute added with defaults (9, 0) and shallow-merged with DEFAULTS on load, so existing users without those keys will still get the 9:00 AM default cleanly.

src/notifications.ts:98-112 scheduleDailySummary now accepts hour/minute and cancel-and-reschedules identifier 'await-daily-summary' with SchedulableTriggerInputTypes.DAILY. Correct for native; web is early-returned (as expected).
seed_data_creation: None. Used seeded alex@example.com (7 awaits, 3 overdue). During testing 1 overdue item (aw_695096f73ce2) was snoozed to 'Next week' via the quick-chip flow — cleanup not performed since main agent may want to re-verify. No new users/awaits created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both new frontend features work end-to-end on the Expo web preview. Login: alex@example.com / password123, then dismiss the onboarding 'Not now' banner. Feature 1: Profile (home-profile-avatar) → Notifications row → toggle notif-daily-toggle ON → notif-digest-time appears → tap → digest-time-sheet opens with options digest-time-sheet-option-{7,8,9,12,18,21}. Feature 2: On Home, Overdue section has overdue-snooze-<id> (containing 'Tomorrow','+3 days','Next week' chips) and overdue-snooze-more-<id>. POST /api/awaits/{id}/snooze fires and returns 200; toast '[data-testid=toast]' shows 'Reminder set · <ddd, D MMM>'. Non-blocking: post-snooze pill doesn't visibly change immediately (react-query refetch race). If main agent wants a smoother UX, add an optimistic cache mutation in useAwaitAction for /snooze responses.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs to RCA. All specified acceptance criteria verified.
